value.name: Miles and Kenneth wait for the ceremony
value.description: Miles and Kenneth stand in suits waiting in the chapel, with Miles visibly nervous about the upcoming wedding.
evidence: Miles and Kenneth wait. Dressed in suits. Miles looks nervous.

value.name: Kenneth congratulates Miles
value.description: Kenneth expresses happiness for Miles and makes a joking, awkward remark about Marylin's ethnicity.
evidence: KENNETH I'm happy for you, pal.
KENNETH Is she Asian?
MILES Asian? No.

value.name: Wrigley arrives with the briefcase
value.description: Wrigley rushes in carrying a briefcase, joining Miles and Kenneth before the ceremony.
evidence: Wrigley, rushes in, carrying a briefcase.
MILES Wrigley?
WRIGLEY Miles.

value.name: Miles introduces Wrigley to Kenneth
value.description: Miles introduces his associate Wrigley to Kenneth and identifies Kenneth as his friend Dr. Beck.
evidence: MILES Kenneth this is my associate, Wrigley. Wrigley this is my friend, Dr. Beck.

value.name: Wrigley recognizes Kenneth as a surgeon
value.description: Wrigley reveals he knows Kenneth from a magazine feature and identifies him as a plastic surgeon.
evidence: WRIGLEY The plastic surgeon!
I read about you in LA Style.

value.name: Miles confirms the pre-nup and ring arrangement
value.description: Miles asks whether Wrigley has the pre-nup, and Kenneth clarifies that he has the ring while Wrigley has the pre-nup.
evidence: MILES Do you have it?
KENNETH I have it.
MILES You have the ring?
KENNETH No. I have the ring. Was I supposed to have a pre-nup?
MILES No. You have the ring. Wrigley has the pre-nup.

value.name: Marylin enters with her friends
value.description: Marylin arrives looking stunning, accompanied by Sarah Sorkin and the pregnant Ramona Barcelona.
evidence: Marylin enters. She looks outstanding.
Her friends, Sarah Sorkin and Ramona Barcelona (who is now visibly pregnant) accompany her.

value.name: Friends greet Kenneth and discuss appointments
value.description: Sarah greets Kenneth warmly, and Ramona jokes about being his future patient after her pregnancy.
evidence: SARAH Dr. Beck!
KENNETH Sarah! How are you?
RAMONA You're Dr. Beck? I have an appointment to see you in March. Right after I lose the babyweight. Which of course, will be after I have the baby...

value.name: Marylin introduces her friends to Miles
value.description: Marylin names Sarah and Ramona for Miles and formally introduces Miles to them.
evidence: MARYLIN Sarah Sorkin. Ramona Barcelona -- this is Miles Massey.
SARAH Hello Miles.
RAMONA Congratulations Miles.

value.name: Marylin acknowledges Wrigley's wedding tradition
value.description: Marylin tells Miles she knows Wrigley from her divorce and wedding and jokes that he is a fixture at marital events.
evidence: MARYLIN I do. He was at my divorce and my wedding. What would a marital related event be without Wrigley?
WRIGLEY It has become a tradition, hasn't it?

value.name: Marylin thanks Wrigley for the berry spoons
value.description: Marylin recalls loving the berry spoons from Wrigley's past gift and thanks him, while Wrigley beams at the praise.
evidence: MARYLIN I loved the berry spoons. (Wrigley beams) I didn't have any. Thank you.

value.name: Miles presents another item for Marylin
value.description: Miles tells Marylin that Wrigley has brought something else for her today, implying the pre-nup is about to be presented.
evidence: MILES Well, Wrigley brought something else for you today, darling.
